title: Meta’s Muse Wonder returns it to the AI model race
teaser: Meta has introduced Muse Wonder, a model built by its new AI lab to compete with leading systems from Anthropic and OpenAI. The company says its largest version ranks ahead of Anthropic’s second-best model on a broad capability index and beats top rivals on some specialist tests. After years in which Meta’s Llama models lost ground to faster-moving competitors, Muse Wonder is evidence of a stronger research effort—but the announcement leaves open how reliably its benchmark gains translate to real work.
